newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Isbank to sign $300-mln loan deal in August.
newsitem.headline: Turk Isbank to sign $300-mln loan deal in August.

text.p: Turkey's Isbank will sign a deal for a $300 million syndicated loan on August 29, a bank official said.
The official said about $320 million of bids for participation was received in the general syndication, initially planned for $250 million.

The loan, priced at 60 basis points over LIBOR, was arranged by Bank of America, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Citibaank, Chase Investment, Commerzbank, Dai-Ichi Kangyo, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Dresdner, Fuji, Nationsbank, Royal Bank of Canada, Sanwa and Sumitomo.
